# Layer 2: Direct RPM Requires
# Platform: centos-7.9-x86_64
# Status: PROJECTED (TXSQL RPMs not available for rpm -qpR)
# Date: 2026-07-22
#
# These are the EXPECTED direct Requires that RPM auto-detection would
# generate for txsql-{common,client,server} RPMs, based on known MySQL
# 8.0 runtime linkage patterns.
#
# ACTUAL requires will be confirmed when TXSQL RPMs exist.

# =============================================================================
# txsql-server
# =============================================================================
# From mysqld binary:
libc.so.6(GLIBC_2.17)(64bit)           # glibc
libpthread.so.0(GLIBC_2.17)(64bit)     # glibc
libdl.so.2(GLIBC_2.17)(64bit)          # glibc
libm.so.6(GLIBC_2.17)(64bit)           # glibc
librt.so.1(GLIBC_2.17)(64bit)          # glibc
libresolv.so.2(GLIBC_2.17)(64bit)      # glibc
libstdc++.so.6(CXXABI_1.3)(64bit)      # libstdc++ (from devtoolset-8)
libgcc_s.so.1(GCC_4.0.0)(64bit)        # libgcc
libaio.so.1()(64bit)                   # libaio
libcrypt.so.1()(64bit)                 # glibc (or libxcrypt on newer)
libssl.so.1.1()(64bit)                 # openssl-libs (or bundled)
libcrypto.so.1.1()(64bit)              # openssl-libs (or bundled)
libcurl.so.4()(64bit)                  # libcurl
libncurses.so.5()(64bit)               # ncurses-libs
libtinfo.so.5()(64bit)                  # ncurses-libs
libsasl2.so.3()(64bit)                 # cyrus-sasl-lib
libldap-2.4.so.2()(64bit)              # openldap
liblber-2.4.so.2()(64bit)              # openldap
libnuma.so.1()(64bit)                  # numactl-libs
libz.so.1()(64bit)                     # zlib
liblz4.so.1()(64bit)                   # lz4 (likely bundled by MySQL)
libzstd.so.1()(64bit)                   # libzstd (likely bundled by MySQL)
libtirpc.so.1()(64bit)                 # libtirpc

# From plugin .so files:
libssl.so.10()(64bit)                  # OPENSSL 1.0.x compatibility (if system)
libcrypto.so.10()(64bit)               # OPENSSL 1.0.x compatibility

# RPM-level deps (scriptlet):
/bin/sh                                 # bash
/sbin/ldconfig                          # glibc
/bin/bash                               # bash

# From systemd integration:
systemd                                  # systemd
systemd-units                            # systemd

# =============================================================================
# txsql-client
# =============================================================================

libc.so.6(GLIBC_2.17)(64bit)
libpthread.so.0(GLIBC_2.17)(64bit)
libdl.so.2(GLIBC_2.17)(64bit)
libm.so.6(GLIBC_2.17)(64bit)
libstdc++.so.6(CXXABI_1.3)(64bit)
libgcc_s.so.1(GCC_4.0.0)(64bit)
libssl.so.1.1()(64bit)
libcrypto.so.1.1()(64bit)
libncurses.so.5()(64bit)
libtinfo.so.5()(64bit)
libz.so.1()(64bit)
libtirpc.so.1()(64bit)

# =============================================================================
# txsql-common
# =============================================================================
# Shared by both server and client:
# - Character set files (.xml)
# - Error message files (.sys)
# - shared libraries (libmysqlclient.so, libmysqld.so)
libc.so.6(GLIBC_2.17)(64bit)
libpthread.so.0(GLIBC_2.17)(64bit)
libstdc++.so.6(CXXABI_1.3)(64bit)
libssl.so.1.1()(64bit)
libcrypto.so.1.1()(64bit)
/bin/sh
